topic: News content API setup and deployment
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on configuring the news content API. [p1] provided two endpoints: one for live data (`/api/news?populate=image`) and another for staging/preview data (`/api/news?publicationState=preview`). 

It was noted that managing impression parameters through a database is inconvenient, and an UI solution would be preferred. [me] stated they would work on the inventory management portion that day.

Regarding deployment, [p1] agreed to start implementing the news content API while [me] would finalize any remaining issues, with the understanding that someone else (Tole) would handle the final deployment.
decisions: The live news content API endpoint requires `populate=image` for correct functionality.
A staging/preview endpoint exists for unpublished news content: `/api/news?publicationState=preview`.
action_items: [p1] will start implementing the news content API.
